title: On the effects of emulated quantum layers on CNN performance and explainability for OCT and dementia imaging
abstract: arXiv:2607.21186v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Hybrid quantum-classical convolutional neural networks have been proposed as an alternative to classical deep learning models. However, executing network components on quantum hardware imposes fundamental limitations, such as gradient estimation through repeated measurements, and increasing the number of qubits can lead to trainability problems such as barren plateaus. Moreover, the reported success of these hybrid networks has been linked to quantum architectures that can be efficiently simulated on classical computers. We investigate whether small, classically simulated quantum circuits can serve as useful components within larger models, as a substitute for purely classical layers. translated_title: 模拟量子层对OCT与痴呆症影像分析中CNN性能及可解释性影响的研究
translated_abstract: 混合量子-经典卷积神经网络被提出作为经典深度学习模型的一种替代方案。然而，在量子硬件上执行网络组件会带来根本性的限制，例如需要通过重复测量来进行梯度估计，而且增加量子比特数量可能引发诸如“贫瘠高原”（barren plateaus）等可训练性问题。此外，这些混合网络所报告的成功，往往与那些可以在经典计算机上高效模拟的量子架构有关。我们研究了小型的、经典模拟的量子电路能否在更大的模型中作为有用的组件，充当纯经典层的替代品。我们对混合量子启发CNN（HQiCNN）与标准CNN架构进行了系统性比较，其中两类模型仅在一个中间层上有所不同：HQiCNN使用模拟的量子电路，而对照模型使用经典对应层，以评估其对OCT（光学相干断层扫描）与痴呆症影像任务中模型性能和可解释性的影响。
tldr: 本文通过仅在一个中间层（模拟量子电路与经典层）上存在差异的系统性对比实验，评估了模拟量子层对OCT和痴呆症影像分析中CNN性能与可解释性的实际影响。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically compares CNNs that differ only in a single intermediate layer—an emulated quantum circuit versus classical counterparts—to evaluate the effects of emulated quantum layers on performance and explainability in OCT and dementia imaging.
